note: Brotli bytes. Lower these by hand when a change shrinks a build; --check fails 2% over, when a fixture bundles a package its budget forbids, or when baseline-only code (0064) reaches a chunk a WebGPU session loads. `fallback` counts the chunks only the baseline tier loads. renderer-min fallback: the WebGL2 shim (gpu-webgl2, ~22 KB) and the baseline strategies; naga (342 KB wasm) loads only on a translation-cache miss.
